verdict.rationale: Native team chat is a fair axis for a work-planning tool like Shortcut, but the evidence pack never documents in-app chat or messaging. The closest items are a Slack integration (a separate chat tool) and Doc collaborators seeing proposed changes. Both are adjacent features, not chatting with the team inside Shortcut itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in
